display.purpose: Smaller section titles, project titles, service names, menu list; lowercase.

headline.purpose: Section-level headings at weight 680: about name, step titles, form title.

title.purpose: Light Jost voice at 500: category filters and testimonial quotes.

module-number.purpose: 01 to 12 numbers on the grid lines, in the rule color.

shadows.name: header-hairline
shadows.purpose: Separates the solid header from content; a rule, not elevation.

shadows.name: ghost-line
shadows.purpose: Outline button on photos and ink.

shadows.name: photo-scrim
shadows.purpose: Legibility scrim for text over photographs only (captions, CTA).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default (expo out) for reveals, underlines, button fills, hovers.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Expo in-out for slats, clip wipes, menu, FLIP recomposition.

motion.name: slat-reveal
motion.value: slats scaleY 1 to 0, 1.2s expo.inOut, stagger 0.07s per column; image 1.18 to 1 over 2s
motion.purpose: Photos uncovered one grid column at a time, triggered at top 80%.

motion.name: word-rise
motion.value: translateY(105%) to 0 inside overflow mask, 1.2s expo.out, stagger 0.07s
motion.purpose: Display titles rise word by word; hero 1.25s, stagger 0.11s.

motion.name: rise
motion.value: opacity 0, translateY(28px) to rest, 1.1s expo.out, batch stagger 0.09s

motion.name: clip-wipe
motion.value: clip-path inset(100% 0 0 0) to inset(0), 1.3s expo.inOut; image 1.25 to 1
motion.purpose: Portfolio photos and hero slide change (from the right, 1.5s, every 5.6s).

motion.name: ink-open
motion.value: clip-path inset(0 var(--m)) to inset(0), scrubbed from top bottom to top 25% (top 50% mobile)
motion.purpose: Ink sections open from the page margin to the screen edge.

motion.name: cta-open
motion.value: clip-path inset(16% 22%) to inset(0), image 1.3 to 1, scrubbed
motion.purpose: Final CTA photo opens from a framed print to full bleed.

motion.name: flip-recompose
motion.value: GSAP Flip 1s expo.inOut, stagger 0.025s; leaving: opacity 0, scale 0.94, 0.5s; entering: clip wipe after 0.25s
motion.purpose: Portfolio filters recompose the grid along the modules.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: No Lenis or smooth scroll, no reveal initial states, all process steps lit, filters relayout instantly, lightbox opacity changes at 0.01s.

components.name: Module Grid Section
components.description: Signature: visible 12-column lines with module numbers behind a lowercase display title offset by one module.
components.css: .ds-grid { position: relative; padding: 64px 24px; background: #f1efea; color: #0f0f0e; } .ds-lines { position: absolute; inset: 0 24px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(12, 1fr); column-gap: 14px; pointer-events: none; } .ds-lines i { position: relative; border-left: 1px solid rgb(15 15 14 / 0.075); } .ds-lines i:last-child { border-right: 1px solid rgb(15 15 14 / 0.075); } .ds-lines b { position: absolute; top: 14px; left: 6px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.04em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: rgb(15 15 14 / 0.18); } .ds-display { position: relative; font-family: 'Jost Variable', 'Jost', 'Futura', sans-serif; font-weight: 720; font-size: 4rem; line-height: 0.92; letter-spacing: -0.04em; text-transform: lowercase; margin: 0; } .ds-display span { display: block; padding-left: calc((100% - 11 * 14px) / 12 + 14px); }

narrative.overview:
Brazilian concrete poetry and Bienal posters are the source. Every word block and every photograph is placed on one rigorous 12-column module grid, and the grid itself is visible: faint hairline column rules with tiny tabular module numbers (01 to 12) sitting at the top of each line. Empty modules are part of the composition; the page is allowed to leave whole columns unfilled so the photographs can lead.

The material is flat graphite ink on off-white paper. Dark sections are the same ink inverted, never a second palette. Words are heavy, tight, lowercase grotesk stacked in short lines and offset from one another by whole modules, like a poem set in metal type. Photographs are hard-edged rectangles snapped to column spans, with no rounding, no frames and no shadows. A single vermilion is rationed to marks of state: the active filter, the current nav item, the primary underline, focus, scroll progress, errors.

Motion speaks the same grammar as the layout: things arrive along the modules. Photos are uncovered slat by slat, one column at a time; words rise out of masks; images wipe in with clip-path; ink sections open from the page margin to the screen edge; the portfolio recomposes along the grid when filtered. Everything uses transform, opacity and clip-path on an expo curve, and all of it collapses to a still, fully legible page under reduced motion.
keyCharacteristics: Visible 12-column grid with module numbers on the lines; 4 lines remain below 900px.
Lowercase heavy Jost display (700 to 780) stacked and offset by whole modules.
Paper and ink as the only two grounds; ink sections invert the same tokens.
One vermilion, used only for active state and the primary underline.
Square everything: radius 0 on photos, buttons, fields, panels.
Module-stepped motion (slats, masks, clip wipes, FLIP) with a full reduced-motion fallback.

rules.name: The One Mark Rule
rules.body: Vermilion marks state or the single primary underline. If a vermilion element does not say "this is active, focused, wrong, or the way forward", it is wrong.

rules.name: The Same Ink Rule
rules.body: A dark section is `data-theme="ink"`: the ground becomes ink, foreground becomes paper, secondary becomes ink gray, lines and accent swap to their ink variants. No other dark palette exists.

rules.name: The Lowercase Poem Rule
rules.body: Display text is lowercase, stacked in short lines, and each line is offset by whole modules (one column plus one gutter, or multiples). Words, not sentences.

rules.name: The Weight Ladder Rule
rules.body: Jost lives at 780 / 760 / 720 for display, 680 for section-level headings, 500 for the light voice. Nothing in between is invented per element.

rules.name: The Module Rule
rules.body: Every photo edge and every offset lands on a column line. Offsets are counted in columns plus gutters, not in arbitrary pixels.

rules.name: The Visible Grid Rule
rules.body: The grid is shown, not hidden: faint lines and module numbers sit behind every grid section, and empty modules are composition, not leftover space.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never float. If something needs separation, use a hairline rule, an ink inversion, or empty modules.

dos: Do place every photo and word block on the 12 columns and express offsets as whole modules (column plus gutter).
Do show the grid lines and module numbers behind grid sections, reducing to four lines below 900px.
Do set display text lowercase in Jost at 700 to 780, tight (-0.04em), stacked and offset.
Do keep vermilion (#c4391f, #e0573c on ink) for active state, focus, errors and the primary underline only.
Do build dark sections by switching to the ink theme, not by adding colors.
Do reveal along the modules: slats per column, words rising from masks, clip-path wipes, ink sections opening from the margin to the edge, FLIP recomposition.
Do animate only transform, opacity and clip-path with expo curves (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) and cubic-bezier(0.77, 0, 0.18, 1)).
Do give every motion a reduced-motion state: no smooth scroll, no reveals, all content and process steps visible, filters and lightbox switch instantly.
donts: Don't round corners or add drop shadows to photos, buttons, fields or panels.
Don't use vermilion as a section ground, a decorative fill or a second accent.
Don't set display text in title case or sentence-long headlines.
Don't let photos float off the columns or arrange them as a free masonry wall.
Don't put parallax on running text; parallax lives inside photo frames.
